title: Exec staff meeting — prep & follow-ups (2026-03-04)
content:
Context / goal:
- Quick sync with execs to align on near-term risks and asks for next 4 weeks. Main goals: 1) confirm Dedicated capacity commitments and runway, 2) surface Private deployment readiness risks, 3) decide on temporary throttling policy for Hosted during end-of-month spikes.

Attendees (tentative):
- Samir (CEO)
- Elena (CTO)
- Diego (VP Revenue)
- Priya (VP Product)
- Aisha (Head of Product Ops) — note taker

Agenda (30–40m):
1) Quick metrics snapshot (5m) — Aisha
   - Hosted API p95 latency: 310ms (target 280ms) — regressions in eu-west region since 3/1
   - Dedicated utilization: 78% overall, some pools >95% (payments, search)
 - Cost: avg token cost down 6% MoM; Dedicated cost per request still 18% higher than forecast due to small batch sizes
2) Private deployments status (7m) — Elena
   - Onboarding: 3 customers in validation, 1 blocked on KMS integration (legal/compliance concern)
   - Risk: on-prem installer failing for arm64-nodes (ticket infra-788)
3) Capacity & routing decision (10m) — Samir + Diego
   - Proposal: temporary throttling (per-tenant QPS cap) for Hosted over weekends for top non-enterprise tenants to protect SLA for Dedicated/Private customers
   - Tradeoffs: monetization impact vs uptime guarantees for paying customers — Diego to estimate revenue exposure if throttled
4) Rollout / ops asks (8m) — Aisha
   - Need go-ahead for canary of throttling policy next Fri (3/12). Rollback plan and comms template drafted (see linked doc).
   - Request SRE headcount reprioritization: move 1 SWE from infra to SRE on a 6-week rotation to help with region stability.
5) Open issues & decisions (remaining time)

Key talking points / notes to remember:
- Latency regression seems correlated with a recent kernel upgrade in eu-west; engineering investigating, but if not fixed by EOD we should route some traffic to eu-central as fallback (smart routing test ready).
- Private KMS issue: legal wants attestation about customer-managed keys — Priya to connect legal + infra lead to expedite (blocked customer: Acme Health).
- Dedicated pool hotspots: Payments pool has 3 models pinned to high-memory variants; infra recommendation: short-term scale-up + autoscale rule change, longer-term: quantize or recommend model variant.

Open questions for execs:
- Are we comfortable with a weekend throttling pilot that will affect ~4% of Hosted revenue? (Need explicit signoff)
- Approve temporary headcount rotation (1 SWE to SRE) — if yes, who is OK to move?
- Accept risk for delaying Private arm64 fix by 2 weeks (customer timeline?)

Action items / follow-ups (owner — due):
- Diego: revenue impact estimate for weekend throttling (range + recommended mitigation) — due 2026-03-05
- Elena: escalate KMS attestation conversation with Legal + Infra, update with target resolution date — due 2026-03-06
- Priya: draft customer comms + FAQ for throttling pilot (tailored for enterprise and non-enterprise) — due 2026-03-05
- Aisha: prepare canary plan doc + rollback checklist, include SRE runbook links — due 2026-03-08
- Infra/SRE (Diego to nominate): quick autoscale rule change for payments pool (temporary) — due 2026-03-06
- SRE: run smart-routing fallback test to eu-central and report performance delta — due 2026-03-04 (ASAP)

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Keep agenda tight; prioritize decisions and explicit signoffs.
- Bring one-slide visuals: 1) p95 latency trend (7d) by region, 2) Dedicated utilization heatmap, 3) estimated revenue impact of throttling (range).
- Have comms draft ready in comments for Samir to approve quickly if we go ahead.

Potential risks if we delay decisions:
- Latency regressions further degrade customer experience and increase support tickets.
- If we don't throttle and Dedicated runs out of headroom, enterprise SLA breaches are possible.
- Delaying KMS attestation will push Private customer X's pilot out of their compliance window.

Quick refs / tickets to paste in meeting:
- infra-788 (arm64 onprem installer failure)
- ops-1293 (eu-west kernel regression investigation)
- product-563 (throttling pilot plan doc)
- https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/EXEC-Q2-OKR-2026

Follow-up plan after meeting:
- Capture minutes + decisions in Confluence (page: EXEC-MINUTES-2026-03-04) — Aisha to publish within 24h
- Create Jira epics for: throttling pilot, KMS attestation, payments autoscale change
- Set 1:1 with Elena next Tue to review Private rollout timeline (30m)

Quick todo (right after meeting):
- Post decision summary in #exec-updates Slack (Samir + Aisha)
- Tag Diego and Elena on the relevant Jira tickets

-- end of prep notes --
